description: Resolve a common EU regulation name to its CELEX id. Returns the curated map of the EU digital/compliance corpus (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, AI Act, DSA, DMA, eIDAS, Cyber Resilience Act, Data Act, …) with CELEX ids, types, dates and one-line summaries. Use this first to turn a name like "GDPR" into the CELEX id the other tools need.

query.description: Optional filter — name/alias/keyword (e.g. "AI Act", "data"). Omit to list the whole corpus.

name: compliance_index
